resale_co.name: Residential Resale Certificate (Residential Change of Owner)
resale_co.lead_time: Fee depends on how soon the inspection is requested after the application is submitted: more than 10 business days is the lowest fee. Submit the signed and sealed survey early (one issued within the past 60 days is recommended).
resale_co.valid_for: 60 days after issue if settlement or occupancy has not occurred
requirements: Recent signed and sealed survey for all single family homes (not required for condos); one issued within the past 60 days is recommended
All open construction permits must be closed before the certificate is issued
House number on the building itself, at least 30 inches above ground, at least 3 inches tall, on a contrasting background, visible from the street; stick-on numbers not accepted
Carbon monoxide alarm outside and within 10 feet of every sleeping area; extra alarm if a bedroom is on another level or more than 10 feet away
Smoke alarms per the year the home was approved; battery-only alarms must be 10-year sealed units
A hardwired or monitored alarm system cannot be reverted to battery-only alarms; monitored systems must be put in test mode for the inspection
No zoning violations; any addition or accessory structure built without zoning or construction permits must be brought into compliance first
Pool fencing and gates must meet Section 305 of the International Swimming Pool and Spa Code
Someone must be present unless the property is completely empty; inaccessible areas fail the inspection
Tax assessor property record card is checked during the inspection

fees.label: Inspection requested more than 10 business days after application
fees.quote: $75.00 When inspection is requested for more than 10 business days after submission of application, when available.

fees.label: Inspection requested 2 to 10 business days after application
fees.quote: $125.00 When inspection is requested between 2 and 10 business days after submission of application, when available.

fees.label: Inspection requested 1 to 2 business days after application
fees.quote: $150.00 When inspection is requested between 1 and 2 business days after submission of application, when available.

fees.label: Inspection requested the same day as application
fees.quote: $200.00 When inspection is requested for the same day as submission of application, when available.

fees.label: First re-inspection (also charged when any part of the property is inaccessible)
fees.quote: the inspector will deem the inspection as "failed," and the $75 re-inspection fee will be required to be paid prior to the scheduling of the first re-inspection

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Residential Resale Application and send it to the Planning & Zoning Department by email (resales@voorheesnj.com), through the SDL online portal, or in person at 2400 Voorhees Town Center. Pay by cash or check payable to Voorhees Township. Include the buyer, agent and certificate email, lock box details, and the survey.
resale_co.contact_title: Zoning Clerk (zoning@voorheesnj.com and srahmad@voorheesnj.com on the Zoning page)

evidence.quote: If you are selling your home, the presence of an unpermitted improvement (a violation) may delay settlement since a resale certificate cannot be issued for a transfer of ownership while a violation exists.
Per §156.037(C)(5)(a)(4) of the Voorhees Township ordinances, a Resale Certificate cannot be issued prior to the Township’s review of a current signed and sealed survey.
Resale Certificates shall become null and void sixty (60) days after a Certificate has been issued if settlement/occupancy has not occurred within that time.
The Construction Office does not schedule resale and rental inspections. Those inspections must be scheduled through the Zoning Department.
Certificate for Resale or Rental of existing buildings (change in ownership or tenancy).

resale_co.notes: Fees are from the current application form (revision 7.02.2026), linked from the Zoning page as of October 20, 2026; no newer form was found. The 2023 fee ordinance (No. 420-23, scanned PDF posted by the Voorhees Fire Department, adopted March 13, 2023) shows the same $75 / $125 / $150 / $200 amounts with slightly different windows ('between 3-10 business days' and 'within 24 hours') and a flat $75.00 per re-inspection for residential resale; the newer form adds $150 for the second and later re-inspections. The tiers count business days from submission of the application to the requested inspection, not days before closing. The form also calls the result a 'Certificate of Conformance' in its zoning item. Non-residential sales use a separate Change of Ownership packet. The Residential Rental Certificate (form revised 9.16.2026), lead-based paint inspection and annual landlord registration are rental programs.

requirements: Battery-only smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units (Voorhees resale packet and Fire Department page)
Carbon monoxide alarm within 10 feet of each sleeping area
Hardwired or monitored alarm systems cannot be downgraded to battery-only alarms

authorities.name: Voorhees Township Planning & Zoning Department (residential smoke/CO inspections, done with the resale certificate inspection)
authorities.lead_time: Same as the resale certificate; see resale fee tiers
authorities.how_to_apply: Use the Residential Resale Application from the Zoning Department; the smoke and CO alarm check is part of that inspection.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Official, Voorhees Township Fire Department (fire code enforcing agency); residential smoke inspections are done by the Zoning Department

evidence.quote: SMOKE DETECTOR INSPECTIONS FOR RESIDENTIAL PROPERTIES ARE COMPLETED THROUGH THE VOORHEES TOWNSHIP ZONING DEPARTMENT.
All battery smoke detectors must be the 10-year sealed battery units.
Our Fire Official Thomas O’Brien oversees the Fire Prevention Bureau.

fire_cert.notes: The Voorhees Township Fire Department (fire code enforcing agency, Fire Official Thomas O'Brien, 2002 S. Burnt Mill Road, 856-783-6630, tom.Obrien@vtfd66.org per the DCA directory) handles commercial inspections, but its page sends residential smoke detector inspections to the Township Zoning Department, and the DCA directory lists the Zoning Department for smoke detector compliance. The fire district was abolished 1/1/2019, so there is one agency for the whole township. No separate smoke certificate fee was found; the resale fee covers it (not repeated here). The 2023 fee ordinance lists only a $25.00 Certificate of Fire Code Status, a different document. The resale packet does not mention a portable fire extinguisher, which the 2025 state law (P.L.2025, c.19) dropped from the sale certificate.

other_items.label: Open permits must be closed
other_items.detail: The resale form requires Township sign-off that all outstanding permits for the property have been closed and finalized before the certificate is issued.

other_items.label: Survey
other_items.detail: A current signed and sealed survey must be reviewed before the Resale Certificate can be issued (single family homes; not condos).

other_items.label: Zoning compliance
other_items.detail: Any zoning violation, including an addition or accessory structure built without permits, must be resolved before the certificate is issued.

open_questions: Whether the Township issues the state-form smoke/CO certificate as a separate document or only the Resale Certificate.
The ordinance text of section 156.037 on amlegal could not be opened; requirement and fee details come from the Township form and the 2023 fee ordinance.
